findings.evidence: MomentSpace.lean:415-423 — the proof uses only `isMomentSolution_momentEvolution_mulVec` and `apply_eq_exp_mul_of_gamma_apply_eq_zero`; the statement mentions `S` only through `integratedCoupling S.alphaS τ₀ τ` and `S.gamma N`. `Matrix.hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const'` (MatrixExponential.lean:45) already supplies the needed derivative with no DGLAP data.
findings.fix: Put it in `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/Analysis/Normed/Algebra/MatrixExponential.lean` for arbitrary `A : Matrix m m 𝕂` and `u`, proved by the same integrating-factor argument run on `Matrix.hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const'` (entrywise, `d/du (exp (u • A)) i j = (A * exp (u • A)) i j = A i i * exp (u • A) i j` under the hypothesis), then derive `momentEvolution_apply_of_gamma_apply_eq_zero`, `IsMomentSolution.apply_eq_exp_mul_of_gamma_apply_eq_zero` (via `eq_momentEvolution_mulVec`) and `momentEvolution_eq_diagonal` from it.
findings.issue: `momentEvolution_apply_of_gamma_apply_eq_zero` contains no DGLAP content: it is the statement that if `∀ j ≠ i, A i j = 0` then `exp (u • A) i j = if i = j then exp (u * A i i) else 0`. It is stated only for `u = integratedCoupling S.alphaS τ₀ τ` and proved via `isMomentSolution_momentEvolution_mulVec` at `Pi.single j 1`, i.e. the general matrix fact is obtained through the ODE machinery of this file.

findings.issue: Entries are fixed to `RCLike 𝕂`, strictly less general than the module this file mirrors and imports: Mathlib's `Matrix.exp_add_of_commute` and neighbours (Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Algebra/MatrixExponential.lean:125-130) hold for `[NormedRing 𝔸] [NormedAlgebra ℚ 𝔸] [CompleteSpace 𝔸]`, and this PR calls that very lemma. The `CompleteSpace (Matrix m m 𝔸)` obstruction the docstring names is the one Mathlib works around in place.

findings.fix: Derive it from the general lemma: `hF.apply_eq_exp_mul_of_gamma_apply_eq_zero (fun j hj => by rw [h]; exact Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne' d hj) τ₀ τ`, rewriting `S.gamma N i i = d i` by `h` and `Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq`.
findings.issue: `IsMomentSolution.apply_eq_exp_mul_of_gamma_eq_diagonal` is a strict special case of `IsMomentSolution.apply_eq_exp_mul_of_gamma_apply_eq_zero` (line 389) — `S.gamma N = diagonal d` gives the row hypothesis for every `i` — but is proved by a separate route through `momentEvolution_eq_diagonal`.

summary: The closed-form block is built at the DGLAP level: a pure matrix-exponential fact (row i of exp(c • A) when row i of A is diagonal) is derived through the moment-space ODE and stated only for one exponent, and the diagonal case is then proved again by a third route. The new Matrix file is also restricted to RCLike entries where the Mathlib module it extends, and which it calls, works for any complete normed algebra.
